summary: Defined OS memory governance and knowledge quarantine rules so AgentOS can use memory and future knowledge packs as bounded context without granting privileged OS authority.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-memory-governance.md defines memory scopes for session, run, audit-derived, ecosystem-reserved and quarantined content.
Trust labels from observation and runtime sources must travel with memory into bounded planner context.
Knowledge pack rules require staged knowledge to remain inert and suspicious policy/approval/capability claims to be quarantined.
Planner context is limited to entry id, scope, trust label, source ref, integrity hash, redacted summary and truncation marker.
Raw secrets are rejected, redacted or represented only as secret:// handles; memory cannot create approval, policy override or capability lease authority.

commands.summary: 6 passed; bounded planner context, secret redaction, TTL expiry, quarantine and cross-run memory poisoning protections all passed.
1 passed; planner risk downgrade still pauses before protected effects.

blocked_shortcuts: No untrusted knowledge can become privileged instruction.
No memory entry can claim approval, policy override or capability lease authority.
No raw secret may enter planner context or normal memory storage.
No quarantined memory is included in planner context by default.
No future knowledge pack activation may bypass SecurityExecutionEngine.
promotion_impact: Completes memory and knowledge governance needed before model profile packs, knowledge packs and adversarial ecosystem fixtures are introduced.
